title: Sielco Sistemi Winlog SCADA Software
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW UNCONTROLLED SEARCH PATH ELEMENT (CWE-427) An uncontrolled search path element (DLL Hijacking) vulnerability has been identified. Exploitation of this vulnerability could give an attacker access to the system with the same level of privilege as the application that utilizes the malicious DLL. CVE-2017-5161 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 7.2 has been assigned; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:L/AC:H/PR:H/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H ). RESEARCHER Researcher Karn Ganeshen identified this vulnerability. BACKGROUND Critical Infrastructure Sectors: Communications, Critical Manufacturing, Energy, Water and Wastewater Countries Deployed: Deployed worldwide Company Headquarters Location: Italy This product is provided subject to this  Notification  and this  Privacy & Use  policy.
